words.def: an event in nature that can be seen and studied
words.ex: A rainbow is a beautiful phenomenon.

words.def: a stream or river that flows into a larger river
words.ex: A small tributary joins the river below the bridge.

words.def: control over how you act, gained by practice
words.ex: It takes discipline to practice violin every day.

words.def: letting some light through but not clear enough to see through
words.ex: The translucent curtains let soft light into the room.

words.def: not wasting money or materials
words.ex: Buying the big box of cereal is more economical.

words.def: something in an experiment that can change
words.ex: In our test, the amount of water was the variable.

words.def: so useful that its worth cannot be measured
words.ex: Your help with the bake sale was invaluable.

words.def: first or most important
words.ex: Our primary goal is to finish the project on time.

words.def: doing or saying something again and again
words.ex: Repetition helps you learn your multiplication facts.

words.def: the part of a story where the main problem is solved
words.ex: In the resolution, the lost puppy finds its way home.

words.def: made to look real in order to trick people
words.ex: The bank found a counterfeit twenty-dollar bill.

words.def: an amazing or unusual sight
words.ex: The fireworks show was a spectacle of color.

words.def: an official statement that announces something
words.ex: The king's declaration was read aloud in the town square.

words.def: the decision made at the end of a trial or contest
words.ex: The judges announced their verdict on the best pie.

words.def: much better than usual
words.ex: Liam is an exceptional artist for his age.

words.def: an unfair liking for one side over another
words.ex: The referee should have no bias toward either team.

words.def: a book or set of books with facts about many subjects
words.ex: The encyclopedia had a whole page about sea turtles.

words.def: able to break down naturally in soil without harming it
words.ex: These forks are biodegradable, so they won't pile up as trash.

words.def: the habit of keeping on trying even when it is hard
words.ex: With perseverance, she finally learned to ride her bike.
